create_population_collage_network: create a PopulationCollage instance with config, device, population size, and segmented image data
render_collage_forward: run the forward pass to render a collage image from transformed and coloured patches
render_high_res_collage: run the forward high res pass to render a tiled high resolution collage image
mutate_collage_patches: copy and mutate collage patch indices and transformer parameters from a parent to a child population member
copy_collage_parameters: copy collage generator parameters including patch indices and transformers between population members
